findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "Shane Wighton is an engineer who used to…" → 8 lines at 30.2px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Moving hoop won’t let you miss" above "PARTS DRAWERS"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section#miss.miss at 900px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "STUFF MADE HERE" → 3 lines (3 words, 87.8px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("STUFF MADE HERE") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Won’t let" (14px); "you miss" (14px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 14 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Home", "Won’t let you miss", "Bad aim, good putt", "Building now"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
